sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: Solution and software architect with a focus on distributed systems, API design, multi-tenancy, and Domain-Driven Design. I have been building software for over 15 years, first through volunteer open-source and community projects (Narutorpg.de since 2009) and professionally since 2019, primarily with PHP/Laravel, Symfony, and TypeScript. Within a distributed restaurant POS platform I designed and own specific components end-to-end: the external REST API with a multi-tenant, permission-scoped access system, and the real-time pivot-event synchronization (Mercure/SSE) inside an event-driven architecture. I think about systems from requirements through to operations, make deliberate architecture decisions, measure the results, and improve iteratively. Currently deepening Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure, Terraform).

sections.heading: SKILLS
lines: Architecture & Systems: Software Architecture, System Design, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture, distributed systems (multi-container, message dedup), modular monolith / package-oriented architecture, multi-tenancy / tenant isolation, API design (REST, OpenAPI), real-time synchronization (Mercure/SSE), Requirements Engineering, SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code

Backend & Integration: PHP (OOP), Laravel, Symfony, API Platform, Laravel Sanctum, JWT, REST APIs, OpenAPI, OAuth, Guzzle, Mercure/SSE, async PHP (amphp), Redis, Laravel Octane, Laravel Horizon, PostgreSQL, MySQL; system integration (MT 5, OPI payment terminals)
Python & Data: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, NumPy, Numba (JIT), pytest, backtesting, data pipelines, algorithm optimization
Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS

DevOps & Quality: Docker, Docker Compose, GitLab CI/CD, Git, Linux, PHPUnit, Codeception/Behat/Pest, BDD (Gherkin), Static Analysis (PHPStan level 9 / Larastan), ECS, Performance Optimization, Security
AI & LLM Engineering: AI Agents, LLM integration, Prompt Engineering, MCP, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AI-assisted development (Claude Code)

items.title: Software Development & Component Architecture
bullets: Core contributor (top-3 of a ~7-person team) on a distributed, multi-component restaurant point-of-sale (POS) platform: a central Laravel/Filament cloud back-office, on-premise location servers, and Capacitor/TypeScript terminals, built on a Domain-Driven, package-oriented Laravel monolith (14 domains, 8 internal Composer packages). I designed and own specific components end-to-end within the existing greenfield platform.

Designed and built the external REST API from the ground up (API Platform on Laravel) with multi-tenant, permission-scoped access control: row-level query extensions, tenant-isolation write guards, Sanctum-based API credentials and permission management, and OpenAPI documentation.

Designed and implemented the real-time pivot-event synchronization (a custom laravel-pivot-events package plus a dedicated PivotEvents domain, delivered via Mercure/SSE) inside an event-driven architecture backed by Redis queues (Laravel Horizon) and Laravel Octane.
Authored automated tests across the stack (PHPUnit, BDD with Behat/Gherkin, Pest, Selenium, Bruno API collections) within a GitLab CI pipeline enforcing PHPStan level 9 (Larastan) and ECS code style.
Containerized development and CI with Docker Compose (PostgreSQL, Redis, TSE emulator) on a platform integrating German fiscal compliance (TSE/KassenSichV, DSFinV-K/TAR) and OPI payment terminals.

items.title: Software Development & Custom Solutions
bullets: Independently designed, built, and maintained custom software and web applications (ticketing systems, websites, marketing tools) from requirements gathering through to operation.
Conceived requirements-appropriate software solutions and designed the underlying database systems; translated business requirements into technical solutions.

Led and coordinated projects, formulated user stories with the team and clients, and communicated directly with clients; the employment reference rates analytical and solution-oriented thinking 'at the highest level' (overall assessment: very good).
Automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc; used AI tools productively for code analysis, architectural design, and automation.

items.title: Development & Coordination
bullets: Major contributor on a team building a long-lived, database-heavy PHP browser game; modernizing a historically-grown legacy codebase toward Symfony and Doctrine ORM (incl. migrations) while preserving the existing architecture.
Analyzed complex legacy dependencies with no existing documentation and coordinated a ~10-person team across technical and organizational tasks.

items.title: Distributed Signal-Execution & Backtesting System
bullets: Designed and built a distributed, event-driven execution system in Python across multiple Docker containers (monitor, FastAPI dashboard, MT 5 integration over RPyC under Wine/VNC).
Reliability design: dual push/poll signal delivery with deduplication keyed on (chat_id, msg_id, text_hash), plus layered risk gates.

Additional algorithmic backtesting system on the event-driven execution framework with walk-forward validation and Monte Carlo portfolio simulation; performance engineering via vectorization and JIT compilation (NumPy, Numba). Extensive test coverage with pytest.

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Designed and evaluated AI workflows, agents, and integrations with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP; orchestrated multi-step tasks.
Optimized prompts and token usage, deliberately weighing cost against output quality, and compared model strengths per task.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events - custom-IDs feature (open-source contribution)
bullets: Extended an existing open-source Laravel package with support for custom IDs and timestamps on pivot tables; worked within its Eloquent relationship internals (BelongsToMany/MorphToMany, model events).
